a10o_1002504.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1002504.text: You should be starting to see Langrenus over there, T.P.

a10o_1002504.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1002504.text: Yes.

a10o_1002504.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1002504.text: 21 minutes.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: OK, T.P. 23 minutes, I'm going to - 22:30, I'm going to connect the ascent batteries. You got your land - PGNS Landing Radar breaker Closed, for sure?

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Oh, yeah, yeah, baby.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: OK.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Houston. I got the ascent batteries connected at this time.

a10_1003359.speaker: Duke
a10_1003359.text: Roger. We see that. Thanks, Snoop. Over.

a10_1003359.speaker: Mission Control
a10_1003359.text: Snoopy .

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: I didn't realize there were so many things to do in such a short time.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Give me that thing, Tom, if you can?

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: OK.

a10_1003359.speaker: Mission Control
a10_1003359.text: Snoopy coming up on 70 degrees east longitude now.

a10_1003359.speaker: Duke
a10_1003359.text: Snoop, Houston. Your ascent batteries look good. Out.

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Roger.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Charlie, we're now about where the horizon is - almost, you know, level - at times seems a little bit high. We're coming into - to a mare area 22 minutes before, before phasing right now. The craters, the new craters, seem to throw out very, very light, light, almost whitish gray by comparison to the dirtier-color whites and grays and browns. Right over the rim - there appears to be almost every fresh crater, there's visible boulders both down in it, on the sides and on the rim.

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Also, Charlie, it looks like we're getting so close all you have to do is put your tail hook down and we're there. (Laughter)

a10_1003359.speaker: Duke
a10_1003359.text: Hey, Snoop. Air Force guys don't talk that way.

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Well, I did fly an F4 that had one on it one time, even though it's an Air Force bird. OK. We're coming right over to the maria. And it really smooth out here, comparatively speaking.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: You should be starting to see Langrenus over there, T.P.

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Yes.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: 21 minutes.

a10_1003359.speaker: Duke
a10_1003359.text: Roger, Snoop. We have you; you should be at Taruntius very soon.

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Roger.

a10_1003359.speaker: Young
a10_1003359.text: OK, Houston. I've got them in the optics now. They're fantastic.

a10_1003359.speaker: Duke
a10_1003359.text: Hey! Great show, Charlie Brown.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: OK. We're at - I don't believe we're quite up to Taruntius yet. We're in - we're in the Foaming Sea - We're past the Sea of Waves and in the Foaming Sea. And the maria gets markedly smooth and flat. There's small craters - a lot of small craters down in it, but the basic surface is extremely smooth. And it appears that the craters go down into it, rather than - than the rims come up out of it.

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: You can tell that this area is definitely lower than that highland area, just as the whole general area.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: OK. I think right over the horizon, we've probably got Taruntius H and Taruntius G coming up. See them, Tom?

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Yes, we've got them, Cernan...

a10_1003359.speaker: Duke
a10_1003359.text: OK, Snoop. Could you come up on expected surface washout? Could you comment on that? Over.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Yes. When you look straight down, there's a definite three-dimensional effect where you can't really tell the depth of craters like we could in the past. And in some cases, you're not even sure whether - whether there is depth to them except that they look a little familiar. It's a little bit hazier and glarier. It looks like we're right over a sub-solar point about now.

a10_1003359.speaker: Young
a10_1003359.text: Boy! Are they down there among them!

a10_1003359.speaker: Duke
a10_1003359.text: Roger. Bet it looks like they're really hauling the mail.

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: What - what did you do?

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Huh? I didn't do anything.

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Oh, sorry.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Yes. We're doing it. Surprisingly enough, Charlie, it really doesn't look like we're moving too fast down here. It's a very nice pleasant pace.

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: In fact, it's exactly like when - tell Deke it's like you went out and practiced the other morning in Florida, as far as the relative bearing rate, it's about the same.

a10_1003359.speaker: Duke
a10_1003359.text: Roger.

a10_1003359.speaker: Duke
a10_1003359.text: Copy. Out.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Seems like we're coming up on my side on Taruntius G and I believe Tom's got his Taruntius H right there on his side. These come out of the horizon differently. They seem to come over the horizon and be much closer to you down here, than up there at 60 miles [111 km].

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Shit, look at the boulders.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: And, again the craters in this area, are craters that are dug out of the surface and not craters that are throwing back from the surface. They're very low, flat rims.

a10_1003359.speaker: Duke
a10_1003359.text: Snoop, you're dropping out. Your voice faded out. We're standing by.

a10_1003359.speaker: Mission Control
a10_1003359.text: Pericynthion time: 100 hours, 43 minutes, 20 seconds.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Roger. It looks like we might be on the verge of [garble] loss of lock, here; I don't know.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Tom, I think you've either got Messier B or Secchi up there on your left in front of you. See it?

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Yep.

a10_1003359.speaker: Duke
a10_1003359.text: Hello, Snoopy. If you read, Houston, we think your aerial is not tracking us too closely. Could you pick us up on the signal strength? Over.

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Houston, Snoopy. From this altitude, the maria still looks fairly smooth as far as overall approach characteristics coming into it.

a10_1003359.speaker: Young
a10_1003359.text: Snoopy, Houston said something about their signal strength or something.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Tell them again - tell me again what you want them to do there, Houston.

a10_1003359.speaker: Duke
a10_1003359.text: Roger, Snoop. We're getting data dropout. It sounds like [garble].

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: OK. We're coming into Apollo Ridge.

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Yes.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: OK. There's Secchi on my right.

a10_1003359.speaker: Duke
a10_1003359.text: Roger. We copy Apollo Ridge.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: There's Secchi on my right! OK, Houston. Houston, if you read, we have Secchi on my right. We're coming into Apollo Ridge. There's the first of the - here's Apollo Rille, right out the window! Very, very easily distinguishable at this point, and it appears to be a couple of hundred feet deep.

a10_1003359.speaker: Mission Control
a10_1003359.text: Apollo Ridge at 42 degree east longitude.

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: It's rounded.

a10_1003359.speaker: Duke
a10_1003359.text: Hello, Snoop. Houston. Do you read? Can you try to tweak up the high-gain signal strength? Over.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Houston, I'm on Omni. I'm not sure whether you're reading, but we're coming over the Apollo Ridge. I just had Secchi on my right - Apollo Ridge appears to be a couple of hundred feet deep, but very smooth at the bottom. We should have the Smokey Basin right out of Tom's window, on the left.

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Yep.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Are you reading, Houston?

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Hello, John. Are you reading?

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: OK. I'm on Omni, and we got good signal strength. I don't know whether they're listening, but we're over Apollo Ridge and we're just passing Smokey Basin.

a10_1003359.speaker: Young
a10_1003359.text: Loud and clear there, Gene-o.

a10_1003359.speaker: Duke
a10_1003359.text: Charlie Brown, Houston. If you read, have Snoopy tweak up the high gain. We're not reading him at all. Over.

a10_1003359.speaker: Young
a10_1003359.text: Roger.

a10_1003359.speaker: Young
a10_1003359.text: Charlie - Snoopy, Houston wants you to tweak up the high gain. They are not reading you.

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: We're coming into perilune now.

a10_1003359.speaker: Young
a10_1003359.text: Snoop, this is Charlie Brown. Over.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: OK, they should have it now. OK. We just passed Mount Marilyn. We're losing high-gain lock. We can't hold them.

a10_1003359.speaker: Young
a10_1003359.text: Houston, Snoopy said they can't hold you on the high gain.

a10_1003359.speaker: Duke
a10_1003359.text: Roger. Stand by.

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Boulders all over the place. OK, You got it?

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Houston, we're on Omni and we just passed Mount Marilyn. As a matter of fact, there's Weatherford Crater, I believe, right in here.

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Yes. Where we ought...

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: What's the time, babe? We're at 14:40. OK. And here - we just...

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: ...there's Teresa Ridge - Right there! We're right over it!

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: OK, T.P. We're coming up on the Bear Mountain. It's right ahead of us. And you should have Maskelyne A. Do you have a big crater, Maskelyne A, right there, right on the edge of our - right in front of you, down straight in front of you on the left?

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Could they have...

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: We have Lonesome Mesa right here.

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Is this Maskelyne A?

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Houston, I don't know whether you read or not, but that's the best we can do.

a10_1003359.speaker: Duke
a10_1003359.text: Snoop, we read you. Standing by.

a10_1003359.speaker: Young
a10_1003359.text: They are still transmitting to you, Houston - but - they're reading you, Snoopy, and they're standing by.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: OK. We're abeam of - we're abeam of Site 1. Tom, give me that a minute. let me see if I can take a couple of pictures.

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: And I've got Censorinus A out here. Hey, let me - I've got Censorinus A, right here, bigger than shit.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Hey, I tell you, we are low! We are close, babe! This is, like, it! And it really looks pretty smooth down there, surprisingly enough.

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Censorinus A has huge boulders all around the rim of it, falling on the inside and outside.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: OK. I've got Maskelyne out here off my right side. We are coming up on Boot Hill which is very easy to distinguish, and Maskelyne. And I see the craters that are going to lead us right into the - right into the landing site.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Oh, Tom, let me get a picture of those rilles! Diamondback.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: We've got Duke Island on the left, just past Boot Hill and we are coming up - I've got Wash Basin just off my right arm - very easily distinguishable.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Tom, ought to have Sidewinder Rille coming up on the left - Tom, give me that...

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Here it comes.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: ...get Maskelyne.

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: What time did we pitch over, 11:40?

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Yeah.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: OK. I've got Diamondback. Diamondback Rille is very easy to see. These rilles look like they may be as much as a couple of hundred feet deep and very smooth. The surface actually looks very smooth, like a very wet clay, but smooth with the exception of the bigger craters.

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Here. Sidewinder Rille is round along the edges. It is flat under, and smooth in the bottom. The ridges are definitely rounded, and it doesn't look like the sides are upturned. OK. I've got Moltke up here on the left and we are coming into the site.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: OK. The best description I can give you of these rilles is of a dry - a dry riverbed out in New Mexico or Arizona someplace.

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Hold it, go VOX. OK. Here we are coming up on the site [garble] Moltke on the left.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: [Garble] Maskelyne G [garble].

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: ...there's plenty of holes there, but there are a few smooth places.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: There's Sabine. OK. We just went over crater number 12, we've got the landing site, Tom's got Moltke right out his left - right. Take a picture of that, babe.

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: OK.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: ... almost like you could reach out and touch Moltke, and we're going just right over the landing site right this moment, and it's - a lot of - a lot of rounded-off craters, a few fresh ones, but basically, it looks pretty smooth, like a gummy grayish sand.

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: OK. My camera failed, I took so many pictures. There's still lots of small craters down there, but I'd say you have about 30 percent of the area that looks free. About 30 per cent. So if you've got Hover time, you can probably make it.

a10_1003359.speaker: Duke
a10_1003359.text: Snoop, Houston, Request Downvoice Backup. Over.

a10_1003359.speaker: Young
a10_1003359.text: Snoopy, Houston wants you to go to Downvoice Backup. Over.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: ...I am, John, I'm in Downvoice Backup.

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: OK.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: We're just going over the landing site right now, and we should be coming up on Ritter - Sabine and Ritter and then Schmitt.

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: OK, here is US 1. US 1 has got a rounded side, and it looks like the whole thing is slumped down an even amount, like it is a huge graben.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Man, that must be - Tom, that must be seven, that must be a thousand feet wide.

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Yes. US 1 is a good - oh, almost a good mile - a thousand feet to a mile wide - even a couple thousand feet to a mile wide. And the whole thing is slumped down. And the plain is still pretty pock-marked with craters, but it looks like you could be able to set down there.

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: We're going to phasing attitude.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: OK.

a10_1003359.speaker: Young
a10_1003359.text: OK.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Goddamn film pack failed. I'm so fed up with this stuff failing.

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Hey. Gene-o, what's the phasing attitude?

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: OK.

a10_1003359.speaker: Duke
a10_1003359.text: Charlie Brown, Houston. Over.

a10_1003359.speaker: Young
a10_1003359.text: Go ahead. Over.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: OK. Let me...

a10_1003359.speaker: Duke
a10_1003359.text: Roger. We had a complete data dropout with Snoopy...

a10_1003359.speaker: Young
a10_1003359.text: ...I read you loud and clear.

a10_1003359.speaker: Duke
a10_1003359.text: OK. Roger. Pass it on: we got 9 minutes till burn; get in the attitude; and they're Go for phasing. Over.

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: I'm starting this right now, Tom.

a10_1003359.speaker: Young
a10_1003359.text: Roger. Snoopy, Houston says you're Go for phasing. Got about 8½ minutes now. Want to get you in the attitude.

a10_1003359.speaker: Young
a10_1003359.text: Snoop, Charlie Brown. Do you read?

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: Oh, look at this!

a10_1003359.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: You know this god-damned film pack failed on me?

a10_1003359.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1003359.text: My Hasselblad just failed!

a10o_1003643.speaker: Duke
a10o_1003643.text: Roger, Snoop. We have you; you should be at Taruntius very soon.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: Roger.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Young
a10o_1003643.text: OK, Houston. I've got them in the optics now. They're fantastic.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Duke
a10o_1003643.text: Hey! Great show, Charlie Brown.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: OK. We're at - I don't believe we're quite up to Taruntius yet. We're in - we're in the Foaming Sea - We're past the Sea of Waves and in the Foaming Sea. And the maria gets markedly smooth and flat. There's small craters - a lot of small craters down in it, but the basic surface is extremely smooth. And it appears that the craters go down into it, rather than - than the rims come up out of it.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: You can tell that this area is definitely lower than that highland area, just as the whole general area.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: OK. I think right over the horizon, we've probably got Taruntius H and Taruntius G coming up. See them, Tom?

a10o_1003643.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: Yes, we've got them, Cernan...

a10o_1003643.speaker: Duke
a10o_1003643.text: OK, Snoop. Could you come up on expected surface washout? Could you comment on that? Over.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: Yes. When you look straight down, there's a definite three-dimensional effect where you can't really tell the depth of craters like we could in the past. And in some cases, you're not even sure whether - whether there is depth to them except that they look a little familiar. It's a little bit hazier and glarier. It looks like we're right over a sub-solar point about now.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Young
a10o_1003643.text: Boy! Are they down there among them!

a10o_1003643.speaker: Duke
a10o_1003643.text: Roger. Bet it looks like they're really hauling the mail.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: What - what did you do?

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: Huh? I didn't do anything.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: Oh, sorry.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: Yes. We're doing it. Surprisingly enough, Charlie, it really doesn't look like we're moving too fast down here. It's a very nice pleasant pace.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: In fact, it's exactly like when - tell Deke it's like you went out and practiced the other morning in Florida, as far as the relative bearing rate, it's about the same.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Duke
a10o_1003643.text: Roger.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Duke
a10o_1003643.text: Copy. Out.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: Seems like we're coming up on my side on Taruntius G and I believe Tom's got his Taruntius H right there on his side. These come out of the horizon differently. They seem to come over the horizon and be much closer to you down here, than up there at 60 miles [111 km].

a10o_1003643.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: Shit, look at the boulders.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: And, again the craters in this area, are craters that are dug out of the surface and not craters that are throwing back from the surface. They're very low, flat rims.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Duke
a10o_1003643.text: Snoop, you're dropping out. Your voice faded out. We're standing by.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Mission Control
a10o_1003643.text: Pericynthion time: 100 hours, 43 minutes, 20 seconds.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: Roger. It looks like we might be on the verge of [garble] loss of lock, here; I don't know.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: Tom, I think you've either got Messier B or Secchi up there on your left in front of you. See it?

a10o_1003643.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: Yep.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Duke
a10o_1003643.text: Hello, Snoopy. If you read, Houston, we think your aerial is not tracking us too closely. Could you pick us up on the signal strength? Over.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: Houston, Snoopy. From this altitude, the maria still looks fairly smooth as far as overall approach characteristics coming into it.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Young
a10o_1003643.text: Snoopy, Houston said something about their signal strength or something.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: Tell them again - tell me again what you want them to do there, Houston.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Duke
a10o_1003643.text: Roger, Snoop. We're getting data dropout. It sounds like [garble].

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: OK. We're coming into Apollo Ridge.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: Yes.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: OK. There's Secchi on my right.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Duke
a10o_1003643.text: Roger. We copy Apollo Ridge.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: There's Secchi on my right! OK, Houston. Houston, if you read, we have Secchi on my right. We're coming into Apollo Ridge. There's the first of the - here's Apollo Rille, right out the window! Very, very easily distinguishable at this point, and it appears to be a couple of hundred feet deep.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Mission Control
a10o_1003643.text: Apollo Ridge at 42 degree east longitude.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: It's rounded.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Duke
a10o_1003643.text: Hello, Snoop. Houston. Do you read? Can you try to tweak up the high-gain signal strength? Over.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: Houston, I'm on Omni. I'm not sure whether you're reading, but we're coming over the Apollo Ridge. I just had Secchi on my right - Apollo Ridge appears to be a couple of hundred feet deep, but very smooth at the bottom. We should have the Smokey Basin right out of Tom's window, on the left.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: Yep.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: Are you reading, Houston?

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: Hello, John. Are you reading?

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: OK. I'm on Omni, and we got good signal strength. I don't know whether they're listening, but we're over Apollo Ridge and we're just passing Smokey Basin.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Young
a10o_1003643.text: Loud and clear there, Gene-o.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Duke
a10o_1003643.text: Charlie Brown, Houston. If you read, have Snoopy tweak up the high gain. We're not reading him at all. Over.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Young
a10o_1003643.text: Roger.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Young
a10o_1003643.text: Charlie - Snoopy, Houston wants you to tweak up the high gain. They are not reading you.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: We're coming into perilune now.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Young
a10o_1003643.text: Snoop, this is Charlie Brown. Over.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: OK, they should have it now. OK. We just passed Mount Marilyn. We're losing high-gain lock. We can't hold them.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Young
a10o_1003643.text: Houston, Snoopy said they can't hold you on the high gain.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Duke
a10o_1003643.text: Roger. Stand by.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: Boulders all over the place. OK, You got it?

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: Houston, we're on Omni and we just passed Mount Marilyn. As a matter of fact, there's Weatherford Crater, I believe, right in here.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: Yes. Where we ought...

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: What's the time, babe? We're at 14:40. OK. And here - we just...

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: ...there's Teresa Ridge - Right there! We're right over it!

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: OK, T.P. We're coming up on the Bear Mountain. It's right ahead of us. And you should have Maskelyne A. Do you have a big crater, Maskelyne A, right there, right on the edge of our - right in front of you, down straight in front of you on the left?

a10o_1003643.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: Could they have...

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: We have Lonesome Mesa right here.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: Is this Maskelyne A?

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: Houston, I don't know whether you read or not, but that's the best we can do.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Duke
a10o_1003643.text: Snoop, we read you. Standing by.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Young
a10o_1003643.text: They are still transmitting to you, Houston - but - they're reading you, Snoopy, and they're standing by.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: OK. We're abeam of - we're abeam of Site 1. Tom, give me that a minute. let me see if I can take a couple of pictures.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: And I've got Censorinus A out here. Hey, let me - I've got Censorinus A, right here, bigger than shit.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: Hey, I tell you, we are low! We are close, babe! This is, like, it! And it really looks pretty smooth down there, surprisingly enough.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: Censorinus A has huge boulders all around the rim of it, falling on the inside and outside.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: OK. I've got Maskelyne out here off my right side. We are coming up on Boot Hill which is very easy to distinguish, and Maskelyne. And I see the craters that are going to lead us right into the - right into the landing site.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: Oh, Tom, let me get a picture of those rilles! Diamondback.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: We've got Duke Island on the left, just past Boot Hill and we are coming up - I've got Wash Basin just off my right arm - very easily distinguishable.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: Tom, ought to have Sidewinder Rille coming up on the left - Tom, give me that...

a10o_1003643.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: Here it comes.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: ...get Maskelyne.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: What time did we pitch over, 11:40?

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: Yeah.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: OK. I've got Diamondback. Diamondback Rille is very easy to see. These rilles look like they may be as much as a couple of hundred feet deep and very smooth. The surface actually looks very smooth, like a very wet clay, but smooth with the exception of the bigger craters.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: Here. Sidewinder Rille is round along the edges. It is flat under, and smooth in the bottom. The ridges are definitely rounded, and it doesn't look like the sides are upturned. OK. I've got Moltke up here on the left and we are coming into the site.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: OK. The best description I can give you of these rilles is of a dry - a dry riverbed out in New Mexico or Arizona someplace.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: Hold it, go VOX. OK. Here we are coming up on the site [garble] Moltke on the left.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: [Garble] Maskelyne G [garble].

a10o_1003643.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: ...there's plenty of holes there, but there are a few smooth places.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: There's Sabine. OK. We just went over crater number 12, we've got the landing site, Tom's got Moltke right out his left - right. Take a picture of that, babe.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: OK.

a10o_1003643.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1003643.text: ... almost like you could reach out and touch Moltke, and we're going just right over the landing site right this moment, and it's - a lot of - a lot of rounded-off craters, a few fresh ones, but basically, it looks pretty smooth, like a gummy grayish sand.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: OK, here is US 1. US 1 has got a rounded side, and it looks like the whole thing is slumped down an even amount, like it is a huge graben.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: Man, that must be - Tom, that must be seven, that must be a thousand feet wide.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: Yes. US 1 is a good - oh, almost a good mile - a thousand feet to a mile wide - even a couple thousand feet to a mile wide. And the whole thing is slumped down. And the plain is still pretty pock-marked with craters, but it looks like you could be able to set down there.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: Goddamn film pack failed. I'm so fed up with this stuff failing.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: Hey. Gene-o, what's the phasing attitude?

a10o_1004822.speaker: Duke
a10o_1004822.text: Roger. We had a complete data dropout with Snoopy...

a10o_1004822.speaker: Duke
a10o_1004822.text: OK. Roger. Pass it on: we got 9 minutes till burn; get in the attitude; and they're Go for phasing. Over.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: I'm starting this right now, Tom.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Young
a10o_1004822.text: Roger. Snoopy, Houston says you're Go for phasing. Got about 8½ minutes now. Want to get you in the attitude.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Young
a10o_1004822.text: Snoop, Charlie Brown. Do you read?

a10o_1004822.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: You know this god-damned film pack failed on me?

a10o_1004822.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: Oh, I tell you, babe, that's something. OK.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: Except I don't have any more [garble].

a10o_1004822.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: What happened to my control systems?

a10o_1004822.speaker: Duke
a10o_1004822.text: Snoop, Houston. We're reading you about three-by now...

a10o_1004822.speaker: Duke
a10o_1004822.text: We're counting 8 minutes to the burn. Over.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: Roger. We're going to phasing attitude.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Duke
a10o_1004822.text: Roger. And you're Go for the burn.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: Yes, You can't imagine the position we can see these things in, pitched way down like this. It looks like we're not very far above them. It's fantastic.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: OK, babe. You might try and get your helmets and gloves on. I went through P30, and we're all good there again.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: What is your attitude, babe? Boy, it's getting dark. OK, I thought we were pointing up in the air.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: Let's hurry up and get this burn completed.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: We has been down among them, babe!

a10o_1004822.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: We got to start doing that earlier.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: I'm reading you. Do you read me?

a10o_1004822.speaker: Young
a10o_1004822.text: OK, you guys. Give it to them.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: It's OK. Verb 06, Noun - minus 16710 and minus...

a10o_1004822.speaker: Young
a10o_1004822.text: Houston, Charlie Brown. They're going into a P40 now.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Duke
a10o_1004822.text: Roger. We copy them, Charlie Brown. Thanks so much.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: Proceed. Yes. We'll do an Auto maneuver.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: Verb 70 - OK, you should have called a Verb 78 in there, babe.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: And, Tom, the AGS is good for a takeover. The AGS is good for a takeover.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: OK. Let me open and close this breaker.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: OK T.P. We've got to get something out of this burn. Engine Gimbal, Enable.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: OK, Stab/Control: DECA Power, Closed; and AELD Closed.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: OK. Stab/Control: DECA Power Closed and AELD Closed.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: EPS Inverter number 1 Closed; I'm sorry. You got it?

a10o_1004822.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: OK. Descent Engine Override coming Closed? AELD coming Closed. Abort Stage coming Closed.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: OK, Tom, if Delta-V to go is less than five (fps) (1.5 m/s), we'll RCS it to zero, 3 Max. If Delta-V to go is less than 25 (fps) (7.6 m/s) but greater than 5 (fps) (1.5 m/s), we've got to stage in RCS to zero.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: If Delta-V to go is greater than 25 (fps) (7.6 m/s) we got to stage and APS to zero. OK?

a10o_1004822.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: Now if we have to go to AGS, or APS, I've got the staging procedures and everything right here.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: After - after burning - if we stage, we'll stage it and burn it in AGS and go.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: If we burn the ascent engine, we'll burn it in AGS.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: Have you got your landing radar on?

a10o_1004822.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: You got to pull that breaker.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: No. It stays on until after this. We do a Verb 79 - afterwards.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: From final Proceed. We're there. Enter.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: OK, 1:46 to go. We have phasing of 176 feet per second (53.6 m/s). OK. 1:30, Gene-o.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: John, we'll go on VOX, so you can read it.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: We are being cut out, but I assume it's loud and clear.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: OK, Tom. Coming up on 35 seconds: Engine Arm Descent? Deadband Min. You are in AGS. A-OK. Go to Auto on the AGS. There's your AGS needle. AGS attitude's is looking good.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: DSKY blanks; hit the Proceed at 5 seconds.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: OK. Babe, the AGS is looking good, there is your AGS attitude...

a10o_1004822.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: OK, and I'll trim out the burn.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: OK, here we go for 26 seconds.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: OK, throttle's up. That's OK. Let it go. We're burning. OK.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: OK. We're burning, John; we're burning!

a10o_1004822.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: It's the Gimbal light. Forget about it, babe. We've got an Engine Gimbal light, but everything is good.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: OK. Throttling up. 127 (fps) (38.7 m/s) to go.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: 86 (fps, 26.2 m/s) to go. 40 (fps, 12 m/s) to go, 40 (fps), 20 (fps, 6 m/s) to go.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: OK, Tom. 1.5 feet per second (0.45 m/s). Let me null it out. Let's go to AGS Attitude Hold.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: OK. OK, we'll go to AGS...

a10o_1004822.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: OK. Go. Hold it. Something's wrong here.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: We're Min Deadband. That's good. Let it go, right here. That's good.

a10o_1004822.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1004822.text: OK good we're done. That's got it.

a10_1005003.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: Oh, I tell you, babe, that's something. OK.

a10_1005003.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: Except I don't have any more [garble].

a10_1005003.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: What happened to my control systems?

a10_1005003.speaker: Duke
a10_1005003.text: Snoop, Houston. We're reading you about three-by now...

a10_1005003.speaker: Duke
a10_1005003.text: We're counting 8 minutes to the burn. Over.

a10_1005003.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: Roger. We're going to phasing attitude.

a10_1005003.speaker: Duke
a10_1005003.text: Roger. And you're Go for the burn.

a10_1005003.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: Yes, You can't imagine the position we can see these things in, pitched way down like this. It looks like we're not very far above them. It's fantastic.

a10_1005003.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: OK, babe. You might try and get your helmets and gloves on. I went through P30, and we're all good there again.

a10_1005003.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: What is your attitude, babe? Boy, it's getting dark. OK, I thought we were pointing up in the air.

a10_1005003.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: Let's hurry up and get this burn completed.

a10_1005003.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: We has been down among them, babe!

a10_1005003.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: We got to start doing that earlier.

a10_1005003.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: I'm reading you. Do you read me?

a10_1005003.speaker: Young
a10_1005003.text: OK, you guys. Give it to them.

a10_1005003.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: It's OK. Verb 06, Noun - minus 16710 and minus...

a10_1005003.speaker: Young
a10_1005003.text: Houston, Charlie Brown. They're going into a P40 now.

a10_1005003.speaker: Duke
a10_1005003.text: Roger. We copy them, Charlie Brown. Thanks so much.

a10_1005003.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: Proceed. Yes. We'll do an Auto maneuver.

a10_1005003.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: Verb 70 - OK, you should have called a Verb 78 in there, babe.

a10_1005003.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: And, Tom, the AGS is good for a takeover. The AGS is good for a takeover.

a10_1005003.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: OK. Let me open and close this breaker.

a10_1005003.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: OK T.P. We've got to get something out of this burn. Engine Gimbal, Enable.

a10_1005003.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: OK, Stab/Control: DECA Power, Closed; and AELD Closed.

a10_1005003.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: OK. Stab/Control: DECA Power Closed and AELD Closed.

a10_1005003.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: EPS Inverter number 1 Closed; I'm sorry. You got it?

a10_1005003.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: OK. Descent Engine Override coming Closed? AELD coming Closed. Abort Stage coming Closed.

a10_1005003.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: OK, Tom, if Delta-V to go is less than five (fps) (1.5 m/s), we'll RCS it to zero, 3 Max. If Delta-V to go is less than 25 (fps) (7.6 m/s) but greater than 5 (fps) (1.5 m/s), we've got to stage in RCS to zero.

a10_1005003.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: If Delta-V to go is greater than 25 (fps) (7.6 m/s) we got to stage and APS to zero. OK?

a10_1005003.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: Now if we have to go to AGS, or APS, I've got the staging procedures and everything right here.

a10_1005003.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: After - after burning - if we stage, we'll stage it and burn it in AGS and go.

a10_1005003.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: If we burn the ascent engine, we'll burn it in AGS.

a10_1005003.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: Have you got your landing radar on?

a10_1005003.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: You got to pull that breaker.

a10_1005003.text: No. It stays on until after this. We do a Verb 79 - afterwards.

a10_1005003.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: From final Proceed. We're there. Enter.

a10_1005003.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: OK, 1:46 to go. We have phasing of 176 feet per second (53.6 m/s). OK. 1:30, Gene-o.

a10_1005003.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: John, we'll go on VOX, so you can read it.

a10_1005003.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: We are being cut out, but I assume it's loud and clear.

a10_1005003.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: OK, Tom. Coming up on 35 seconds: Engine Arm Descent? Deadband Min. You are in AGS. A-OK. Go to Auto on the AGS. There's your AGS needle. AGS attitude's is looking good.

a10_1005003.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: DSKY blanks; hit the Proceed at 5 seconds.

a10_1005003.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)

a10_1005003.text: OK, here we go for 26 seconds.

a10_1005003.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: OK, throttle's up. That's OK. Let it go. We're burning. OK.

a10_1005003.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: OK. We're burning, John; we're burning!

a10_1005003.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: It's the Gimbal light. Forget about it, babe. We've got an Engine Gimbal light, but everything is good.

a10_1005003.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: OK. Throttling up. 127 (fps) (38.7 m/s) to go.

a10_1005003.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: 86 (fps, 26.2 m/s) to go. 40 (fps, 12 m/s) to go, 40 (fps), 20 (fps, 6 m/s) to go.

a10_1005003.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: OK, Tom. 1.5 feet per second (0.45 m/s). Let me null it out. Let's go to AGS Attitude Hold.

a10_1005003.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1005003.text: OK. Go. Hold it. Something's wrong here.

a10_1005003.text: Looked real good and the burn was steady, we had the Descent Quantity light on twice, we had the Engine Gimbal light on, the Master Warning and all those good things, but we just pressed right on. Over.

a10o_1011053.text: Yes, it's beautiful.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: Houston, just for information, every time we lose track with the S-band antenna it happened and it happens to bang into the stops, it pops the S-band antenna circuit breaker on 16. It's done that about three times...

a10o_1011053.speaker: Duke
a10o_1011053.text: Roger.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: ...but it appears to recover all right.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Duke
a10o_1011053.text: Roger. Snoop, Houston. That's a normal..

a10o_1011053.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: [Garble] I'm going Omni antennas at this time.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Duke
a10o_1011053.text: Roger. We copy on the Omnis, and that's normal indication for the steerable: when it goes into the stops it will pop that breaker.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: Down Voice Backup. That's Off; that's Off. OK, you got a hot mike, Tom

a10o_1011053.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: OK.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: OK, let's go to Verb 41, Noun 72. Enter. Plus 00000, Enter, plus 28300, Enter. See whether it's going.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: Radar is driving. Looks good.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: Alright. Pull your breakers.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: Alright. Rendezvous Radar, DC, PGNS, Open. Rendezvous Radar, AC Bus A, Open.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: Got your AOT Lamp breaker Closed?

a10o_1011053.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: AOT Lamp, Closed. Go.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: And we call for Acrux at this point.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: OK. Let me look at it. We're really using the fuel up on these maneuvers.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: What's that look like to you?

a10o_1011053.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: OK. Roll is 211. That isn't bad. Pitch - that's OK. Go to it? Auto. Proceed.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: Boy, it doesn't waste any time, does it?

a10o_1011053.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: This thing feels like a big garbage can.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: I tell you, it really does. Like it's banging against your head.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: OK, I've got a reticle. That's a start.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: Oh, there's the Earth.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: (Cough) You got the Earth again?

a10o_1011053.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: Right there.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: Beautiful.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: Oh, magnificent, Charlie, or Joe, or Tom. (Laughter) God dang that's unbelievable, isn't it?

a10o_1011053.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: Yep.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: Looks like it's hanging out there on a string where you can touch it. Where the hell are we going?

a10o_1011053.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: Go to Acrux. When you're there, you're there.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: Oh, man are we there. This alignment is so good, it's - it's pathetic.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: OK. You ready? We're going to go to...

a10o_1011053.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: Oh, yeah, that's good. Don't even trim it.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: OK, I'm going to go to PGNS and Pulse?

a10o_1011053.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: Yes.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: There. Proceed.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: PGNS and Pulse.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: I'm going to see what...

a10o_1011053.speaker: Young
a10o_1011053.text: Did you guys turn off your tracking light?

a10o_1011053.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: No. Tell him we've maneuvered.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Young
a10o_1011053.text: OK. I guess you maneuvered, because I don't see you.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: We've just maneuvered to start tracking Acrux. Over.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Young
a10o_1011053.text: OK.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: The reticle on this thing is really bad. It won't stand it.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Duke
a10o_1011053.text: Snoop, Houston. We read you about three-by. Over.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: Roger, Houston. This is Snoopy. We're starting to mark on Acrux now for our P52. Over.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: There's a Y, Tom.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Duke
a10o_1011053.text: Roger, Tom. We copy in the P52. Over.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: Yep.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: Stand by, Tom. Go.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: Roger.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: OK.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: OK.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: Batteries went dead.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: Batteries what?

a10o_1011053.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: On the Hasselblad. Went dead.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: I had a film pack that jammed!

a10o_1011053.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: Then the batteries went dead (laughter). Oh, well.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: Ready to mark what? Y.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: Mark Y.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: Mark Y, again.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: Mark Y.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: Mark Y, again.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: Mark Y.

a10o_1011053.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1011053.text: Boy, no wonder John's going blind.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Ready to mark what? Y.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Mark Y.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Mark Y, again.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Mark Y.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Mark Y, again.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Mark Y.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Boy, no wonder John's going blind.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Either one?

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Either one.

a10_1012136.speaker: Duke
a10_1012136.text: Snoopy, Houston. To improve the comm, we'd like you to go to S-Band to Voice and S-Band ranging, Off. Over.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Roger. S-Band-Voice; S-Band Ranging, Off. Over.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: OK.

a10_1012136.speaker: Duke
a10_1012136.text: And Charlie Brown, Houston. When you lose the high gain, then go to Omni Delta. Over.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: That's what it calls for, right here.

a10_1012136.speaker: Young
a10_1012136.text: Roger. Omni Delta.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: How does that look to you? We're still in AGS by the way, babe.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: It looks OK.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: OK. Ready?

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Ready? Go.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: It's going to go this way.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Yes.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: There it is, bigger than love.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Coming in, too.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Tom, that alignment we had; you know where the star is? The alignment we had is under the cross-hairs.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Is that right?

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Under the cross hairs. That alignment we had was so good.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: They might want to change the antennas since we moved, I don't know.

a10_1012136.speaker: Young
a10_1012136.text: I read you, Snoop.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Hello, Houston. This is Snoopy. How are you reading now?

a10_1012136.speaker: Duke
a10_1012136.text: Roger, Tom. You're about three-by now. A little bit better. Over.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Roger. Charlie, I'm reading you loud and clear now. Over.

a10_1012136.speaker: Duke
a10_1012136.text: Roger, We - we have low bit rate, that's all, Snoop. When you get through your P52, we'd like your torquing angles.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Roger. And on the first Automaneuver to the star, Houston - to Acrux - it put the reticle right on the very center of the star there. So it looks like our first alignment was beautiful.

a10_1012136.speaker: Duke
a10_1012136.text: Roger, Snoop. We copy. Over.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: And we're now marking on Antares.

a10_1012136.speaker: Duke
a10_1012136.text: Roger, Snoop. Out.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: You know, John could really be going blind by the time he finishes this flight, after doing all this stuff.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Yes.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Mark either, Tom.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Either one.

a10_1012136.speaker: Young
a10_1012136.text: Did you guys see that mark I just bought?

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Hello, Charlie Brown. Snoopy. Were you calling?

a10_1012136.speaker: Young
a10_1012136.text: No. I was talking to Houston.

a10_1012136.speaker: Duke
a10_1012136.text: Charlie Brown, Houston. Go ahead. Reading you about three-by. Over.

a10_1012136.speaker: Young
a10_1012136.text: Roger. Did you see that Mark I just bought? With the big Delta-V and everything? Did you all read the data?

a10_1012136.speaker: Duke
a10_1012136.text: Charlie Brown, Houston. Say again. You're unreadable.

a10_1012136.speaker: Young
a10_1012136.text: Roger. I say again. Do you all read what I'm doing?

a10_1012136.speaker: Duke
a10_1012136.text: Roger. We see you're in P20. Over.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Program alarm. Too many marks? Verb 5.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: I probably marked on the same thing twice. What's that say?

a10_1012136.speaker: Young
a10_1012136.text: Roger. I just bought a rather large optics mark and it brought it right back up there into the scope here.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: OK, I guess maybe that's right.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: I got to Reset. Key Release.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: OK. Proceed.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: And Proceed.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Beautiful.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: OK, you want to write those down, or you want me to?

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: I'll get them.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Houston, the star angle difference is 4 balls 2. Houston, are you reading?

a10_1012136.speaker: Duke
a10_1012136.text: Roger. Go ahead. 4 balls 2 on the star angle difference. How about the torquing angles?

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: OK. Minus 00169, plus 00050, plus 3 balls 66.

a10_1012136.speaker: Duke
a10_1012136.text: Roger. We copy, Snoop. Out.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Oh, hell. Let's do a real quick check here.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: What do you want? You want to check the COAS?

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Yes. Do you want to check the COAS?

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Check the COAS, position 5.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: What star, have you got out in front of you?

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: I've got the Earth. Go get An - what about Antares? What did you just mark on? Antares?

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Yes. I just marked on Antares.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Let's take it up to it. Ready?

a10_1012136.speaker: Young
a10_1012136.text: What kind of range you got, Tom? About 200 miles [370 km]?

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Wait a minute. Did I do that right?

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: No, no, no.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Why no, no, no?

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Call 52 again.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Give it approximate range.

a10_1012136.speaker: Duke
a10_1012136.text: Charlie Brown, Houston - Charlie Brown, Houston. We are satisfied with your P20. Your NAV's looking good to us. Over.

a10_1012136.speaker: Young
a10_1012136.text: Roger. Looks good to me too.

a10_1012136.speaker: Duke
a10_1012136.text: And, John, you are barely readable, about two by. Stand by. We might have an antenna problem.

a10_1012136.speaker: Young
a10_1012136.text: Roger. We got one. I'll go to Omni D.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Where'd that angle come from?

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Forget it, ignore it, ignore it.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: It shouldn't be in there; I'll try to zero it.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Zero it.

a10_1012136.speaker: Duke
a10_1012136.text: Charlie Brown, Houston.

a10_1012136.speaker: Young
a10_1012136.text: Houston, Charlie Brown. How do you read?

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Auto.

a10_1012136.speaker: Duke
a10_1012136.text: We are looking right up your tailpipe there, and your comm is pretty bad. Did you copy, Charlie Brown?

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Ready?

a10_1012136.speaker: Duke
a10_1012136.text: We are looking up your tailpipe, the comm is pretty bad.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Yes.

a10_1012136.speaker: Young
a10_1012136.text: Houston, Charlie Brown. Omni D. How do you read?

a10_1012136.speaker: Duke
a10_1012136.text: Snoopy, go ahead.

a10_1012136.speaker: Duke
a10_1012136.text: Charlie Brown. Houston. Go ahead.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: You got it?

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Yes. [Garble]. Hold on now, let's do 1.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: There it is, babe - oh, beautiful. How's that look?

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: A quarter of a degree down.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Why don't you just write it on there?

a10_1012136.speaker: Duke
a10_1012136.text: Charlie Brown, Houston. We'll have LOS in 101:36.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Oh, I'll make it a third.

a10_1012136.speaker: Duke
a10_1012136.text: We'll see you over the hill at 102:22. And, Snoop, LOS for you, 101 - correction, 101:37, AOS 102:25. Over.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: If you're satisfied. terminate it.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Go - go back to P00.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Call it again, just right over it. OK, Tom. Let's go to the attitude to find tracking, and we've got to track now again. At...

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: This is Snoopy. Roger. We got that.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: We want to try and get a number of marks here. At minus 1:29, and how far are we now? The burn is at 102:55, so we're at 1:20, so we want to go find it.

a10_1012136.speaker: Duke
a10_1012136.text: Roger.

a10_1012136.speaker: Duke
a10_1012136.text: Roger, Charlie Brown and Snoop, as you are going over the hill, all the systems are Go. We're all Go here on the ground, and it's looking great. Over.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Thank you, Charlie. Snoopy's Go here. Our P52's complete. We're going to pick up P20 again.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: OK. Tom. if you want to find out where it is - Want to go to the target? I've got the AGS needles for you.

a10_1012136.speaker: Duke
a10_1012136.text: Copy.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Yes, let's go to AGS.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: OK.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: I'm in the -

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: You want this in AGS?

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: No. I want it DAP first.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: OK. now you can find out where it is. There's where it is.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Okay. I'll go. Okay, I'm in Direct. I'll go down to here.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Now on the Orb-rate ball at this time. What time is it. Tom; 101:34. And it's normally been 101:24? I guess we're about 150 miles from John. huh?

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Yes. Hey, where's the food?

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Hey, Charlie Brown. This is Snoop. I guess we are about 150 miles from you.

a10_1012136.speaker: Young
a10_1012136.text: Roger.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: And our P50 - our P52 is complete. We're coming over to start tracking on you.

a10_1012136.speaker: Young
a10_1012136.text: Yes. I show you [garble] 179.22 [nautical miles, 331.9 km] [garble].

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Sounds right.

a10_1012136.speaker: Duke
a10_1012136.text: Charlie Brown, this is Houston. Did you get your AOS/LOS times? Over.

a10_1012136.speaker: Mission Control
a10_1012136.text: And we have lost the signal on Charlie Brown . About 40 seconds away from losing the signal with Snoopy . And Snoopy has gone behind the Moon now on the 13th lunar revolution. We acquired Charlie Brown first. He reported that Snoopy had reported the DOI burn and that he felt it was a good one. And then when Snoopy came within range, Tom Stafford and Gene Cernan confirmed that the Descent Orbit Insertion burn had been on time and they were reading an onboard orbit of 61.2 by 9.2 nautical miles [113.3 x 27.4 km]. They were down among the boulders, obviously very impressed at what they were seein

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Whew! How about some foodsville?

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: I guess so, babe. I just - I'm so sick and tired of these god-dang magazines failing. You know it?

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Where's the food bag?

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: It's up in that two-man food bag.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: I want to watch this come in.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: All we got left is a roll of interior film.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Everything else is gone?

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: I'll have to check. I can't get the damn thing to work at all.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: OK, I guess we ought to talk for the record. What we observed as we came across the mare area into the landing site, the basic area looked fairly smooth...

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Actually, it looked amazingly smooth, Tom, I thought.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: It looked amazingly smooth, and it looks like we have plenty of landing surface down...

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: I think you can land down there in and among those holes.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Yes.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: This works after you jam that contact open, but you don't have time to jam a god-dang contact open.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: I can't hold my - the hose is floating up, you know it?

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Boy, chicken again. And that waters good now.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Got bubbles?

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: No. Yes, there is.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Let's see, we've got to get some tracking on this guy. We're late now.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Yes. Shit.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: That's the trouble with these darn air vents.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: What do we have in the way of 70 millimeter film? Jack was saying we could strip the back side of that area...

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: The Hassel...

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: ...on top - that Hasselblad.

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: ...the Hasselblad went dead, babe!

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: The whole Hasselblad?

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Just as I was - That's what I was bitching about: the Hasselblad burned out as I hit the landing site! That's why I was so fucking mad.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Are you kidding?

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: I'm not kidding. It's dead!

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: It doesn't work at all?

a10_1012136.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: No.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: On one of my magazines, you have to ja - Look at, even now, you got to jam it in. Look it. Light goes out - there it goes.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: I'm so sick and tired of film that doesn't - that doesn't check out working beforehand.

a10_1012136.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10_1012136.text: Boy, that ascent engine is going to be a kick in the - in the ass.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: Either one?

a10o_1012318.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: Either one.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Duke
a10o_1012318.text: Snoopy, Houston. To improve the comm, we'd like you to go to S-Band to Voice and S-Band ranging, Off. Over.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: Roger. S-Band-Voice; S-Band Ranging, Off. Over.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: OK.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Duke
a10o_1012318.text: And Charlie Brown, Houston. When you lose the high gain, then go to Omni Delta. Over.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: That's what it calls for, right here.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Young
a10o_1012318.text: Roger. Omni Delta.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: How does that look to you? We're still in AGS by the way, babe.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: It looks OK.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: OK. Ready?

a10o_1012318.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: Ready? Go.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: It's going to go this way.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: Yes.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: There it is, bigger than love.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: Coming in, too.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: Tom, that alignment we had; you know where the star is? The alignment we had is under the cross-hairs.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: Is that right?

a10o_1012318.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: Under the cross hairs. That alignment we had was so good.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: They might want to change the antennas since we moved, I don't know.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Young
a10o_1012318.text: I read you, Snoop.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: Hello, Houston. This is Snoopy. How are you reading now?

a10o_1012318.speaker: Duke
a10o_1012318.text: Roger, Tom. You're about three-by now. A little bit better. Over.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: Roger. Charlie, I'm reading you loud and clear now. Over.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Duke
a10o_1012318.text: Roger, We - we have low bit rate, that's all, Snoop. When you get through your P52, we'd like your torquing angles.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: Roger. And on the first Automaneuver to the star, Houston - to Acrux - it put the reticle right on the very center of the star there. So it looks like our first alignment was beautiful.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Duke
a10o_1012318.text: Roger, Snoop. We copy. Over.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: And we're now marking on Antares.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Duke
a10o_1012318.text: Roger, Snoop. Out.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: You know, John could really be going blind by the time he finishes this flight, after doing all this stuff.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: Yes.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: Mark either, Tom.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: Either one.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Young
a10o_1012318.text: Did you guys see that mark I just bought?

a10o_1012318.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: Hello, Charlie Brown. Snoopy. Were you calling?

a10o_1012318.speaker: Young
a10o_1012318.text: No. I was talking to Houston.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Duke
a10o_1012318.text: Charlie Brown, Houston. Go ahead. Reading you about three-by. Over.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Young
a10o_1012318.text: Roger. Did you see that Mark I just bought? With the big Delta-V and everything? Did you all read the data?

a10o_1012318.speaker: Duke
a10o_1012318.text: Charlie Brown, Houston. Say again. You're unreadable.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Young
a10o_1012318.text: Roger. I say again. Do you all read what I'm doing?

a10o_1012318.speaker: Duke
a10o_1012318.text: Roger. We see you're in P20. Over.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: Program alarm. Too many marks? Verb 5.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: I probably marked on the same thing twice. What's that say?

a10o_1012318.speaker: Young
a10o_1012318.text: Roger. I just bought a rather large optics mark and it brought it right back up there into the scope here.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: OK, I guess maybe that's right.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: I got to Reset. Key Release.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: OK. Proceed.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: And Proceed.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: Beautiful.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: OK, you want to write those down, or you want me to?

a10o_1012318.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: I'll get them.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: Houston, the star angle difference is 4 balls 2. Houston, are you reading?

a10o_1012318.speaker: Duke
a10o_1012318.text: Roger. Go ahead. 4 balls 2 on the star angle difference. How about the torquing angles?

a10o_1012318.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: OK. Minus 00169, plus 00050, plus 3 balls 66.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Duke
a10o_1012318.text: Roger. We copy, Snoop. Out.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: Oh, hell. Let's do a real quick check here.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: What do you want? You want to check the COAS?

a10o_1012318.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: Yes. Do you want to check the COAS?

a10o_1012318.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: Check the COAS, position 5.

a10o_1012318.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: What star, have you got out in front of you?

a10o_1012318.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012318.text: I've got the Earth. Go get An - what about Antares? What did you just mark on? Antares?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Duke
a10o_1012838.text: Charlie Brown, Houston. Go ahead. Reading you about three-by. Over.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Young
a10o_1012838.text: Roger. Did you see that Mark I just bought? With the big Delta-V and everything? Did you all read the data?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Duke
a10o_1012838.text: Charlie Brown, Houston. Say again. You're unreadable.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Young
a10o_1012838.text: Roger. I say again. Do you all read what I'm doing?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Duke
a10o_1012838.text: Roger. We see you're in P20. Over.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Program alarm. Too many marks? Verb 5.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: I probably marked on the same thing twice. What's that say?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Young
a10o_1012838.text: Roger. I just bought a rather large optics mark and it brought it right back up there into the scope here.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: OK, I guess maybe that's right.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: I got to Reset. Key Release.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: OK. Proceed.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: And Proceed.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Beautiful.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: OK, you want to write those down, or you want me to?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: I'll get them.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Houston, the star angle difference is 4 balls 2. Houston, are you reading?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Duke
a10o_1012838.text: Roger. Go ahead. 4 balls 2 on the star angle difference. How about the torquing angles?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: OK. Minus 00169, plus 00050, plus 3 balls 66.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Duke
a10o_1012838.text: Roger. We copy, Snoop. Out.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Oh, hell. Let's do a real quick check here.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: What do you want? You want to check the COAS?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Yes. Do you want to check the COAS?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Check the COAS, position 5.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: What star, have you got out in front of you?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: I've got the Earth. Go get An - what about Antares? What did you just mark on? Antares?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Yes. I just marked on Antares.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Let's take it up to it. Ready?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Young
a10o_1012838.text: What kind of range you got, Tom? About 200 miles [370 km]?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Wait a minute. Did I do that right?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: No, no, no.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Why no, no, no?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Call 52 again.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Give it approximate range.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Duke
a10o_1012838.text: Charlie Brown, Houston - Charlie Brown, Houston. We are satisfied with your P20. Your NAV's looking good to us. Over.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Young
a10o_1012838.text: Roger. Looks good to me too.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Duke
a10o_1012838.text: And, John, you are barely readable, about two by. Stand by. We might have an antenna problem.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Young
a10o_1012838.text: Roger. We got one. I'll go to Omni D.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Where'd that angle come from?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Forget it, ignore it, ignore it.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: It shouldn't be in there; I'll try to zero it.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Zero it.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Duke
a10o_1012838.text: Charlie Brown, Houston.
