a10o_1012838.speaker: Young
a10o_1012838.text: Houston, Charlie Brown. How do you read?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Auto.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Duke
a10o_1012838.text: We are looking right up your tailpipe there, and your comm is pretty bad. Did you copy, Charlie Brown?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Ready?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Duke
a10o_1012838.text: We are looking up your tailpipe, the comm is pretty bad.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Yes.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Young
a10o_1012838.text: Houston, Charlie Brown. Omni D. How do you read?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Duke
a10o_1012838.text: Snoopy, go ahead.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Duke
a10o_1012838.text: Charlie Brown. Houston. Go ahead.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: You got it?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Yes. [Garble]. Hold on now, let's do 1.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: There it is, babe - oh, beautiful. How's that look?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: A quarter of a degree down.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Why don't you just write it on there?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Duke
a10o_1012838.text: Charlie Brown, Houston. We'll have LOS in 101:36.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Oh, I'll make it a third.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Duke
a10o_1012838.text: We'll see you over the hill at 102:22. And, Snoop, LOS for you, 101 - correction, 101:37, AOS 102:25. Over.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: If you're satisfied. terminate it.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Go - go back to P00.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Call it again, just right over it. OK, Tom. Let's go to the attitude to find tracking, and we've got to track now again. At...

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: This is Snoopy. Roger. We got that.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: We want to try and get a number of marks here. At minus 1:29, and how far are we now? The burn is at 102:55, so we're at 1:20, so we want to go find it.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Duke
a10o_1012838.text: Roger.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Duke
a10o_1012838.text: Roger, Charlie Brown and Snoop, as you are going over the hill, all the systems are Go. We're all Go here on the ground, and it's looking great. Over.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Thank you, Charlie. Snoopy's Go here. Our P52's complete. We're going to pick up P20 again.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: OK. Tom. if you want to find out where it is - Want to go to the target? I've got the AGS needles for you.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Duke
a10o_1012838.text: Copy.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Yes, let's go to AGS.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: OK.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: I'm in the -

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: You want this in AGS?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: No. I want it DAP first.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: OK. now you can find out where it is. There's where it is.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Okay. I'll go. Okay, I'm in Direct. I'll go down to here.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Now on the Orb-rate ball at this time. What time is it. Tom; 101:34. And it's normally been 101:24? I guess we're about 150 miles from John. huh?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Yes. Hey, where's the food?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Hey, Charlie Brown. This is Snoop. I guess we are about 150 miles from you.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Young
a10o_1012838.text: Roger.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: And our P50 - our P52 is complete. We're coming over to start tracking on you.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Young
a10o_1012838.text: Yes. I show you [garble] 179.22 [nautical miles, 331.9 km] [garble].

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Sounds right.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Duke
a10o_1012838.text: Charlie Brown, this is Houston. Did you get your AOS/LOS times? Over.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Mission Control
a10o_1012838.text: And we have lost the signal on Charlie Brown . About 40 seconds away from losing the signal with Snoopy . And Snoopy has gone behind the Moon now on the 13th lunar revolution. We acquired Charlie Brown first. He reported that Snoopy had reported the DOI burn and that he felt it was a good one. And then when Snoopy came within range, Tom Stafford and Gene Cernan confirmed that the Descent Orbit Insertion burn had been on time and they were reading an onboard orbit of 61.2 by 9.2 nautical miles [113.3 x 27.4 km]. They were down among the boulders, obviously very impressed at what they were seein

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Whew! How about some foodsville?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: I guess so, babe. I just - I'm so sick and tired of these god-dang magazines failing. You know it?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Where's the food bag?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: It's up in that two-man food bag.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: I want to watch this come in.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: All we got left is a roll of interior film.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Everything else is gone?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: I'll have to check. I can't get the damn thing to work at all.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: OK, I guess we ought to talk for the record. What we observed as we came across the mare area into the landing site, the basic area looked fairly smooth...

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Actually, it looked amazingly smooth, Tom, I thought.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: It looked amazingly smooth, and it looks like we have plenty of landing surface down...

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: I think you can land down there in and among those holes.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Yes.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: This works after you jam that contact open, but you don't have time to jam a god-dang contact open.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: I can't hold my - the hose is floating up, you know it?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Boy, chicken again. And that waters good now.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Got bubbles?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: No. Yes, there is.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Let's see, we've got to get some tracking on this guy. We're late now.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Yes. Shit.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: That's the trouble with these darn air vents.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: What do we have in the way of 70 millimeter film? Jack was saying we could strip the back side of that area...

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: The Hassel...

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: ...on top - that Hasselblad.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: ...the Hasselblad went dead, babe!

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: The whole Hasselblad?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Just as I was - That's what I was bitching about: the Hasselblad burned out as I hit the landing site! That's why I was so fucking mad.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Are you kidding?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: I'm not kidding. It's dead!

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: It doesn't work at all?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: No.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: On one of my magazines, you have to ja - Look at, even now, you got to jam it in. Look it. Light goes out - there it goes.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: I'm so sick and tired of film that doesn't - that doesn't check out working beforehand.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Boy, that ascent engine is going to be a kick in the - in the ass.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: There. Are you ready for it?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Wait a minute. OK, now I am. Go ahead. Do I put it in PGNS Auto and let the Z-axis track?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Yes. Let me get near it, so it doesn't...

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: What is it?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Put it in Auto Track, Tom, and we'll call up 20 again.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: It's been looking right at it, I guess, huh?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Son of a gun, it did it again.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Oh, sh- Reject that there.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: How about some fruit cocktail? Does that sound good?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: I'd love some.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: There's - there's a mark, Tom.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Young
a10o_1012838.text: Are you guys looking directly at me? Over.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: That's affirm. We're tracking on you now, John.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Young
a10o_1012838.text: Roger. I'm checking my lights.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Tom, do I put it in Z-axis track here, do you know?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Go ahead, go ahead.

a10o_1012838.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Or do I take it out?

a10o_1012838.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o_1012838.text: Go to PGNS and Auto.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: John, we're looking at 130 - almost (1)35 miles (250 km) and 305 feet per second (93 m/s). Look at that.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: Look at that fuel go.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: Oh, man, you're right on the nugget.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Young
a10o-1014451.text: [Garble].

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: We got - we got one horrendous update about the first mark, and then that's it, and everything is like tenth of a foot per second (0.03 m/s).

a10o-1014451.speaker: Young
a10o-1014451.text: That's beautiful.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: That Z-axis tracking puts you right on the old money. Have you got your flashing light on?

a10o-1014451.speaker: Young
a10o-1014451.text: Yes, [garble].

a10o-1014451.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: I don't think he can see us.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: I don't think we can see that far - There's a little reflected light, but I don't - I don't think we can see it. Let me see that God-dang Hasselblad, I'm so fed up with the God-dang...

a10o-1014451.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: You can't do a thing, babe, it's burned out. Absolutely, the batteries went dead. I took the batt...

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: Doesn't even work with the backup.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: No, shit, it went dead, and I switched the batteries around...

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: You switched batteries?

a10o-1014451.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: You bet your life. I'm not going to hear you and the ground go u-n-n-h then u-n-n-gh.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: Hey, John, would you believe that Tom's Hasselblad went completely out after all the Mickey Mouse of trying to get backs to work, and then my sequence camera has two packs that you have to jam in, twist, and turn before they'll work, and when you're trying to do it in a hurry, there ain't anyway.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Young
a10o-1014451.text: Look, sunshine.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: We're in darkness yet, sort of. Hey, yes, we're in darkness yet, John. We're coming up on sunrise.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: Tom, let's take what pictures we can with this sequence camera.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: Yep.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: You got it open wide?

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: Yes, part way. Let me open it some more.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: It's awful dark down there.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: I felt like we could have got out and walked, you know it?

a10o-1014451.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: Yeah.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: Gee, I'm sure glad we had every bit of - of simulator time we've had.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: You bet. OK. How does that look? 102:55. OK, that's good.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: Oh, there's that central peak, babe...

a10o-1014451.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: What one?

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: I'm trying to figure out where we're coming in.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: How about minus 01832. That look good?

a10o-1014451.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: Yes. It's retrograde and up.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: OK. How's that look? OK?

a10o-1014451.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: Yeah. Leave about a 9 by 43 on the board.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: 220.9 should be the total.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: How come we're tracking him upside down?

a10o-1014451.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: That's why we ended up started. Proceed.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: That's good. I don't have much film, babe. I want to take some of it coming back down.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: Yes.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: Oh, that's great, babe.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: One more big burn, and then it's like Gemini.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: Yes. Like in the old days, Gene-o.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Young
a10o-1014451.text: You guys did good, man. You're just great!

a10o-1014451.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: What did he say?

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: John, just wait there for us.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Young
a10o-1014451.text: That machine of yours is working pretty good too, ain't it?

a10o-1014451.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: Yes.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: Sure is.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: Hey, do you still - 46.2 by 103 (85.6 by 191 km). That's good.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Young
a10o-1014451.text: Say again. Over.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: OK. How did your VHF ranging work, John?

a10o-1014451.speaker: Young
a10o-1014451.text: I have 130.52 (miles) (241.72 km) by 3, by 2, by...

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: My God, look at that! That's great!

a10o-1014451.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: Beautiful. Beautiful.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Young
a10o-1014451.text: That's incredible.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: Yep.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: John, you can't believe these thrusters in here. It sounds like somebody pounding on the side of a garbage can. The whole thing creaks and moans.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Young
a10o-1014451.text: It what?

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: It's not a dull thud, like it is in the Command Module. It's like a big garbage can you're standing in the middle of and someone's banging on the lid.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Young
a10o-1014451.text: Oh, boy, [garble] that sounds real bad.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: Thank you, sir. I appreciate that.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: Here, we got to get some food, because it's going to get busy again.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Young
a10o-1014451.text: That's what it sounded like to me [garble] Man, this lunar surface is [garble] bunch of craters.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: Yes.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Young
a10o-1014451.text: [Garble] I feel like I was there with you.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: Yeah.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Young
a10o-1014451.text: I was getting a vicarious thrill by watching you guys disappear amongst them. That's beautiful.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: Yes. We were right down there among them. Hey...

a10o-1014451.speaker: Young
a10o-1014451.text: I could see that.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: Hey, that new white crater - you know Censorinus A, that Jack's interested in?

a10o-1014451.speaker: Young
a10o-1014451.text: Yes.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: That thing has big white and black boulders, both on the inside and outside, and I mean they are huge. I'd estimate it'd be 80 to 100 feet (24 to 30 meters) in diameter, those boulders.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Young
a10o-1014451.text: Did you give me insertion Delta-V's and times?

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: No but I will. You want them?

a10o-1014451.speaker: Young
a10o-1014451.text: Yes.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Young
a10o-1014451.text: Go ahead [garble].

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: Ah, Delta-V, Noun 81, is minus 0183.2.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Young
a10o-1014451.text: OK.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: Plus all balls and minus 0123.5.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Young
a10o-1014451.text: Roger. Mine is 183, plus 0.2, plus all balls, and minus 0122.5.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: Right. Minus 123.5.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: That's it, John. Do you have the CSI time that they gave us originally?

a10o-1014451.speaker: Young
a10o-1014451.text: Negative. Over. I need the CSI and CDH time; CSI and TPI time.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: OK. The original one was - CSI is 103:45:34.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Young
a10o-1014451.text: OK.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Young
a10o-1014451.text: OK.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: Alright?

a10o-1014451.speaker: Young
a10o-1014451.text: Got them.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: How is our home up there?

a10o-1014451.speaker: Young
a10o-1014451.text: Oh, it's too roomy for me.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: Hey, Tom. we're - we're in fatsville on fuel so far. That's good.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: Well, you have to go ... that's OK.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: What are you using for a garbage can? This thing right here?

a10o-1014451.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: That's a good place.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: Top - top row would be a good garbage can.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: Yes.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: (Coughing)

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: I told Jack that we were going to get a 70-millimeter filmstrip of this back here but, babe, there's no way. We don't - The whole damn 70-millimeter camera quit, and two 16-millimeter film packs may or may not work. One happens to be the interior film.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Young
a10o-1014451.text: Listen, babe. I tell you. I've been so busy I wouldn't know if there's any Moon down there or not. I might as well be back in the simulator.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: It's about the same here.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: I think you're with us.

a10o-1014451.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: That damn star - star is right smack in the center of that mother, babe. Right smack in the center. And your COAS came out good, huh?

a10o-1014451.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1014451.text: Yes. A third of a degree down.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Young
a10o-1015822.text: Yes. Me, too. Boy, I ... really sound good. ... right in the ..., I'm sure.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Probably is, John. We're reading 100 and oh - I guess...

a10o-1015822.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy) & Cernan (onboard Snoopy) together
a10o-1015822.text: 158 miles (292 km).

a10o-1015822.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: How are our ascent batteries? We got plenty - Are they off the line? We've got plenty of them?

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: They're back off. We've got 35 volts in them. 34 in one and 35 in the other,

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Got one big thing to go - two big things - staging and insertion.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: I'll tell you one thing, John. I feel more at home standing up in here than I do laying down in there. I never did understand that.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Young
a10o-1015822.text: Roger, Gene.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: I believe you could really go down and land with this bear.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Young
a10o-1015822.text: I'm sure ...

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: I think Tom and I were surprised. Weren't you, Tom? It is - it looks a lot smoother down there than I first thought.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Yes.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: That pisses me off so much that that camera failed, Tom.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Yes.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: You changed the batteries and everything in that. God! We ought to have someone's ass. And I know these film packs are not tried individually on the camera.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: I guess we is going to go nice and high. Hey, we just pegged our range-rate meter.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Yes.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: That's where to stop, by the way.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: ... for you auxiliaries. Beautiful. OK.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Young
a10o-1015822.text: I'm taking marks at 178 miles (330 km), that ain't bad.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: OK. What do you want to do now?

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Rendezvous Radar breaker, Open?

a10o-1015822.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: OK.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Yes, go to Auto. Rendezvous Radar breaker, Open?

a10o-1015822.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Yep.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: AC Bus breaker Open?

a10o-1015822.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: See.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Yep.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Now minus 40 minutes. I can't see that. I'll start - I'll connect the ascent batteries; start working on that.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: [Garble].

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Sure be nice to know where the hell we are.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Want us to turn over?

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Can you read that clock up there, Tom? Insertion minus what?

a10o-1015822.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: 51 (minutes).

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Huh?

a10o-1015822.speaker: Young
a10o-1015822.text: Boy, if this thing isn't working like a charm! It's beautiful.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: I'm glad to hear that.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Young
a10o-1015822.text: I have you guys, right in the middle of the optics, and I...You look like a bright star.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Where - where are we?

a10o-1015822.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: We're up above him. Until we roll.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Oh, we're up above you, that's right.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Yes.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: We're up...

a10o-1015822.speaker: Young
a10o-1015822.text: You're up above at 201 miles (372 km). Man, this is good visibility. I mean to tell you.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: You want some grape juice? You want some...

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: I know where we are. No, I don't want anymore, Tom.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: I bet we could see him if - if - if we were looking a little while ago. No, I guess not.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: No.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: I know where we are, though, babe.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: OK.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Right here.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Let me get this food squared away.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: We're right here. I got these all picked out. This one, this one, this one; we're right here. And John, we're about going over the top of 297; that's at 150[°] East.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Young
a10o-1015822.text: Roger. Gene-o, these things - these things don't operate like - out in frigging space like the simulator does.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Where are we at?

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Where's that monocular, Tom?

a10o-1015822.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Shoot.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: God. I wish we had a camera.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Well, I don't know.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Is it in your purse?

a10o-1015822.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: We went into the heat of battle trying to get that camera. Here.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Thank you, sir.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Young
a10o-1015822.text: I'm tracking you guys with 20 degrees of trunnion angle, now. This is just a beautiful thing.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Well, we were saying -

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Here's exactly where we are. Right here. Over on your side, you ought to have 14, Tom. Big, big, big crater.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Got it.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: You got it?

a10o-1015822.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Yes.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Yep, there it is, I see it from here.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Hey, why don't we pitch around for it? OK.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: And we don't have a God-danged 70-millimeter to shoot this with. That -

a10o-1015822.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Let's see, we want to be tracking him later on, don't we?

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Yes, at minus 36 minutes, we track him again, so we might just as well pitch down a little bit.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Yes, we'll pitch down and -

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Roll over?

a10o-1015822.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Yes.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: (Coughing) Yes, that'd be better. Watch that roll on the 8-ball, though.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Yes, yes.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: You want a brownie?

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: God, you're just all full of good food today. Thank you.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: We've been busy, Gene-o. In darkness, time goes fast (laughter).

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: I'm not sure whether water's better in here or not. Did you see this? I'm going to take that back and give it to Jack.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: Yes.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Young
a10o-1015822.text: What did you guys do - pick up a rock?

a10o-1015822.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: No, this is Jack Lousma. I've got a United States Marine Corps big gold and blue and red emblem on my armrest.

a10o-1015822.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1015822.text: We're coming straight down. There Jack's crater again. (Laughter)

a10o-1021010.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: OK. You want to track José...

a10o-1021010.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: Won't take so long to bring it up, when we do it next time.

a10o-1021010.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: There's that one crater I shot so many times, that's got boulders on it? You see it? It's the little volcanic one, right there. See that rascal?

a10o-1021010.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: Yep. Now why don't you pitch up a skosh. Here, let me see if the - Oh, I was going to see the AGS to find out where you are, but -

a10o-1021010.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: Yes, go ahead.

a10o-1021010.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: I will. Wait a minute until I finish this.

a10o-1021010.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: I'm in mode - I'm in Pulse. Go ahead.

a10o-1021010.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: OK.

a10o-1021010.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: AGS. Computer.

a10o-1021010.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: Yes, there you go. There's this big one right down here. XV.

a10o-1021010.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: You know, if your eyes were a photograph, it'd be great.

a10o-1021010.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: I'm going to lock on. There's our landing radar.

a10o-1021010.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: There's...

a10o-1021010.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: She's 50 degrees.

a10o-1021010.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: You really have to be careful with this film, when you don't have any left. There's the one Jack marked that he wants. I'll get it for him.

a10o-1021010.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: Hey, when do we fire the helium tanks? [Garble].

a10o-1021010.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: Not yet, babe.

a10o-1021010.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: You want some more brownies?

a10o-1021010.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: No.

a10o-1021010.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: [Garble] go hungry.

a10o-1021010.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: That music even sounds outer-spacey, doesn't it? You hear that? That whistling sound?

a10o-1021010.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: Yes.

a10o-1021010.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: Whooooooooooo.

a10o-1021010.speaker: Young
a10o-1021010.text: Did you hear that whistling sound, too?

a10o-1021010.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: Yeah. Sounds like - you know, outer-space-type music.

a10o-1021010.speaker: Young
a10o-1021010.text: I wonder what it is.

a10o-1021010.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: Hey, Tom. Is your - is your insulation all burned off here, on the front side of your window over here? Right...

a10o-1021010.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: Yeah.

a10o-1021010.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: Mine's all burned off. isn't that weird - eerie, John?

a10o-1021010.speaker: Young
a10o-1021010.text: Yes, I got it, too. I was going to see who was outside.

a10o-1021010.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: You mark that set of features, Gene-o. I'm going to fix us some grape juice. OK?

a10o-1021010.speaker: Young
a10o-1021010.text: OK man. I've got you 269 miles (498 km) over the [garble] Man, that's [garble] that's just fabulous.

a10o-1021010.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: You'll want the LGC.

a10o-1021010.speaker: Young
a10o-1021010.text: Roger. I'm [garble].

a10o-1021010.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: There's the one Jack wants a picture of, over there. I'll get that one for him with this camera, Yes, these pictures that [Lunar] Orbiter took are fantastic.

a10o-1021010.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: Bet I'm locked on a side lobe.

a10o-1021010.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: Yes, we sure is getting high.

a10o-1021010.speaker: Young
a10o-1021010.text: Yes. 286 miles [530 km]. Oh, this radar is [garble] great.

a10o-1021010.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: Yes. I got it.

a10o-1021010.speaker: Young
a10o-1021010.text: It's going to go right out to 310 [nautical] miles [574 km]. Just like we said.

a10o-1021010.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: Is it really?

a10o-1021010.speaker: Young
a10o-1021010.text: Yes. I'll tell you when you get to 327 [nautical miles, 605 km]. You don't - you don't know when AOS is ... do you?

a10o-1021010.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: Yes, I've got it written down. AOS for us is 102:25. [Cough.]

a10o-1021010.speaker: Young
a10o-1021010.text: It's 102:21 for me.

a10o-1021010.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: OK. 40 minutes, babe. I got to connect the ascent batteries.

a10o-1021010.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: OK.

a10o-1021010.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: OK. Stand by BATs 1 and 3, High Voltage, Off/Reset. Bat's 1...

a10o-1021010.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: OK.

a10o-1021010.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: Boy, that sure is weird music.

a10o-1021010.speaker: Young
a10o-1021010.text: We're going to have to find out about that. Nobody will believe us.

a10o-1021010.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021010.text: No. It's a whistling, you know, like an outer space-type thing.

a10o-1021010.speaker: Young
a10o-1021010.text: Probably due to the VHF ranging, I'd guess.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Yes. I wouldn't believe there's anyone out there. OK, Tom, I'm going to call up P20.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: We want to pressurize our APS here. You get your Rendezvous Radar breakers all In?

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Oh, yes. I'm locked on to him.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: OK.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: It may be a side lobe.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: It's weird, isn't it?

a10o-1021815.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Isn't that weird?

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: I think that's a side lobe.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Is it? Huh?

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Yep.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: See what happens now.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: It ain't doing, babe. Why don't you go ahead and lock on by yourself again.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Shit, why don't you find them? Well, let me - let me do it this way, see whether it will find them. We got to get going here, we got to pressurize and everything.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Yeah, I know it.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: P20 doesn't work worth a darn.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Tom, why don't you get them manually.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: OK. OK, let's go up to P00, huh?

a10o-1021815.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Pick them up manually.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: AGS.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Mission Control
a10o-1021815.text: This is Apollo Control at 102 hours, 21 minutes. We're about a minute away from acquisition of Charlie Brown . About 4 minutes away from acquisition of Snoopy . Snoopy will be making another low pass over the lunar surface this time on the order of 11 nautical miles [20 km], and will perform staging, jettisoning the descent stage, and then 10 minutes after descent stage the insertion maneuver. This maneuver is designed to retrograde maneuver, and it's designed to bring down the high ... that we achieve with the phasing maneuver. This ... was necessary to put the Lunar Module behind Charlie Bro

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Call P20.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: That's where the AGS says he is, right?

a10o-1021815.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: That's where the AGS says he is.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: You're Deadband, Min?

a10o-1021815.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Yeah. The AGS is pretty good. Its state vector's updated.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Boy, this is - this is lots more sissy [sensitive] than the simulator. Deadband, Min? OK.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Duke
a10o-1021815.text: Hello, Charlie Brown. Houston. Over.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Young
a10o-1021815.text: Roger. I'm looking at 316.45 miles [586.07 km] on the - on the radar right now.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Duke
a10o-1021815.text: Roger. We copy. We'd like you to go to P00 and Accept. We have a state...

a10o-1021815.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: This thing is working?

a10o-1021815.speaker: Duke
a10o-1021815.text: Roger. We'd like you to go to P00 and Accept. We have a state vector for you and a change on your backup, insertion PAD, if you're ready to copy. Over.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Look at that! John, are you still in track attitude, babe?

a10o-1021815.speaker: Young
a10o-1021815.text: Go ahead. Over.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Duke
a10o-1021815.text: OK. Delta-V X and Noun 81...

a10o-1021815.speaker: Young
a10o-1021815.text: Go ahead over.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Duke
a10o-1021815.text: Roger. Delta-V X and Noun 81 changes to plus 01720. Over.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: I'll bet we don't even...

a10o-1021815.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Hello, Charlie Brown; this is Snoopy. Do you read?

a10o-1021815.speaker: Young
a10o-1021815.text: Roger. Delta-V X , plus 01270.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Hello, Charlie Brown; Snoopy. Do you read?

a10o-1021815.speaker: Duke
a10o-1021815.text: Roger. That's negative.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Young
a10o-1021815.text: Yes. I just barely read you there, Snoop.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: No track.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Duke
a10o-1021815.text: Charlie Brown, that was a bad readback on the Delta-V...

a10o-1021815.speaker: Young
a10o-1021815.text: Say again. Over.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: That's why this thing wouldn't track. OK, let's pressurize, babe.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: OK, do you want to put your helmets and gloves on?

a10o-1021815.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Monitor your ascent helium pressure, propellant temperature.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Young
a10o-1021815.text: Say it again there, Charlie.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Duke
a10o-1021815.text: Roger, John. It's plus 01720. Over.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: OK.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: OK, Ascent Helium, Reg 1 and 2, Open; talkbacks' gray.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Go.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Young
a10o-1021815.text: Roger. 01720.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Ascent Helium Selects, Both.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Both.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Duke
a10o-1021815.text: That's affirmative.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Master Arm, On.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Master Arm, On.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Helium Pressure, Fire.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Duke
a10o-1021815.text: Charlie Brown, Houston. I cut you out at the beginning of the pass. Say again, what were you going to say? Over.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Young
a10o-1021815.text: Nothing important. I'm about to lose - I just lost range and went to 320.50 miles (593.6 km), and I'm no longer in voice contact with Snoopy. I think we're just flat out of range.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: OK, Master Arm coming Off [garble].

a10o-1021815.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: I bet you still - Why isn't that pressure going down? And that one coming up.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Duke
a10o-1021815.text: Roger. We copy.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Young
a10o-1021815.text: I can hear him very faintly in the background.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Hello, Charlie Brown; Snoopy.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Duke
a10o-1021815.text: Roger. Charlie Brown, Houston. It's your computer. We're through with the load. Over.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: We've got pressures. Don't we?

a10o-1021815.speaker: Young
a10o-1021815.text: Roger. Thank you.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Yes, but I want to watch it go up; I guess it's going awful slow.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Oh, look out there. Oh, if I only had a camera! Get it. Camera.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Oh, shoot.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: f:11; f:11. You got f:4 of those - those - Yes, now you've got f:11, yes. Beautiful.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Hello, Charlie Brown; Snoopy.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Young
a10o-1021815.text: I'm just about to lose you, there.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Son of a bitch, where is he?

a10o-1021815.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Hello, John, do you read us?

a10o-1021815.speaker: Young
a10o-1021815.text: Just barely, you guys. Did you stage?

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Hello. Houston, this is...

a10o-1021815.speaker: Young
a10o-1021815.text: Go ahead. Go ahead there, babe.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: I can't get radar lock. Hello...

a10o-1021815.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: We ought to be able to call them now.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Hello, Hello, Charlie Brown. Snoopy. Do you read?

a10o-1021815.speaker: Young
a10o-1021815.text: Roger. Read you loud and clear now. Weak but clear.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Turning the Master Arm, Off.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Young
a10o-1021815.text: I read you guys.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Hello, Houston. How do you read Snoopy?

a10o-1021815.speaker: Duke
a10o-1021815.text: Roger, Snoopy. Reading you five-by. Over.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Roger. Would you ask Charlie Brown if he's still in track attitude. I can't get any lock on at this distance out here. Over.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Duke
a10o-1021815.text: Roger, He had you - He broke lock at 320 miles (592 km) on the VHF. Stand by. We'll ask him on his attitude.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Roger.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Duke
a10o-1021815.text: Charlie Brown, Houston. Are you still in tracking attitude?

a10o-1021815.speaker: Young
a10o-1021815.text: Roger.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Duke
a10o-1021815.text: Charlie Brown, Houston. Are you still in tracking attitude.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Young
a10o-1021815.text: I'm in attitude 180 which is where I'm...

a10o-1021815.speaker: Duke
a10o-1021815.text: Roger.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Young
a10o-1021815.text: ...supposed to be right now.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Duke
a10o-1021815.text: Roger, Charlie Brown. We copy. Snoop, Houston. He's in attitude as called for out in the Flight Plan. 180 pitch. We got your ascent looks good, the ascent battery looks good. Over.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Roger. We've just pressurized the ascent tanks, and they look good.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: Tom, did - did we really - I'm not - I guess...

a10o-1021815.speaker: Duke
a10o-1021815.text: Roger. If you'll give us your computer, we need P00 and Data. We have a state vector for you.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: OK. Zero, zero.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: You've got it.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: That's it.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: We really hit ascent. God damn, that thing just didn't seem to - maybe it was so high to start with that it didn't...

a10o-1021815.speaker: Duke
a10o-1021815.text: Copy, Snoop. Out.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1021815.text: I'd guess we couldn't get any lock on at all out here. We had him, and he just slowly faded out.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Duke
a10o-1021815.text: Hello, Charlie Brown. This is Houston.

a10o-1021815.speaker: Young
a10o-1021815.text: This is some attitude?

a10o-1021815.speaker: Duke
a10o-1021815.text: Charlie Brown, this is Houston. We show you loaded T IG incorrectly. In P30. T IG is 102:55:01.40. Over.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: Look at that, Tom.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Duke
a10o-1022909.text: Correction, correction...

a10o-1022909.speaker: Young
a10o-1022909.text: It may be 102...

a10o-1022909.speaker: Duke
a10o-1022909.text: Charlie Brown, that was my fault. T IG time is 102:58:01.00. Over.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: They changed? Oh, that's his T IG time.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Young
a10o-1022909.text: Roger. 0100.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Duke
a10o-1022909.text: Affirmative. Out.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Mission Control
a10o-1022909.text: That's the ignition time if Charlie Brown has to perform the maneuver in case Snoopy can't.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: OK, we got - 15 minutes from staging.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: Yep.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: OK, I've got to - I got to knock off the rendezvous radar and go to - to staging attitude. OK?

a10o-1022909.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: OK.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Young
a10o-1022909.text: OK. How does that look to you?

a10o-1022909.speaker: Duke
a10o-1022909.text: Looks real fine, Charlie Brown.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Duke
a10o-1022909.text: Snoop, Houston. We got the load in. The computer's yours. Over.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: Roger, Houston. Thank you very much.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: Goddam this whole thing.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: And, Houston, this is Snoopy. We've got about 14 minutes to staging. I'm going to go ahead and maneuver to staging attitude.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Duke
a10o-1022909.text: Roger, Snoop. We copy. Could you comment on your cameras? We might be able to help you out those. Over.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: Roger. On the Hasselblad it looks like both batteries have gone dead. Over.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Duke
a10o-1022909.text: Copy. Both batteries dead on the Hasselblad. How about the sequence?

a10o-1022909.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: I'll tell him in a minute. I'll tell in a...

a10o-1022909.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: OK. OK, yep - We're on the ascent. I want to get over there, Gene-o.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: OK. On the sequence [16-mm Maurer sequence camera], I've got two film packs that you have to practically jam, wire, and ... step on to get them to make electrical contact so the camera will run. I've got one of them to run, and I'll try to get the other one to run.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: OK.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Duke
a10o-1022909.text: We copy. Thanks a bunch. We'll work on it for you. Over.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: It's just hard to do that when you're coming across a landing site and you expect it to work.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: OK, let's recheck 30 [P30] again.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Duke
a10o-1022909.text: Roger, Gene. We copy.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: Okay, go ahead.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: And Snoopy's going to be maneuvering at this time.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Duke
a10o-1022909.text: Roger.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: : Open your Rendezvous Radar breaker, Tom. PGNS and AC Bus.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: Yes, I've already got it open. Tried to get that Max distance there locked on, but it just wouldn't - Oh, this time has gone fast, Gene-o.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: Yes, it has. OK, let me - we're right on. Let's get our helmets and gloves on, and then we'll go - we'll do - go through the cabin.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: I'll get that out of your way.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: Give me a hand there. Push on that. That's got it.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: It's right here to receive it.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: Yep. Keep getting it -

a10o-1022909.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: OK, Tom. Let me - let me call these out.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: Yes.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: Help you with - OK, I've got all the ascent batteries...

a10o-1022909.speaker: Mission Control
a10o-1022909.text: We're 11 minutes away from staging and 21 minutes away from ignition for the insertion burn.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Young
a10o-1022909.text: Hey, you guys must be about 250 miles [463 km] out, would you?

a10o-1022909.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: ...on the line, and all the descents Off.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: OK, T. P., I'm reading you. OK, you ready?

a10o-1022909.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: OK.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Young
a10o-1022909.text: Charlie Brown to Snoopy. Over.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: Suit Gas Diverter valve, Pull/Egress.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: Go.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: Cabin Repress valve, Closed.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: OK, stand by for another bang. Ready?

a10o-1022909.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: OK, I'm ready. Gollee! OK, Descent O 2 , Closed.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: Descent O 2 is coming Closed.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: OK, Ascent O 2 number 1, Open.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: Open.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: OK, Regs A and B to Egress.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: Reg A to Egress. B to Egress.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: OK, Water Tank Select to Ascent.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: Oops! I need to - what the hell's wrong here?

a10o-1022909.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: OK, I'll check the Ascent Batteries. Oh I'm in a Deadface, Tom.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: OK.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: We are Deadfaced. OK, on your side AC Bus A DECA Gimbal, Open.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: OK.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: Flight Display Thrust, Open.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: Go.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: Propulsion Descent Helium, Reg/Vent, Open.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: Go.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: Heater Landing Radar, Open.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: Go.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: Stab/Control, DECA Power, Open.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: Go.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: PGNS Landing Radar, Open.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: Go.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: OK, let's take another look at those APS temperatures and pressures. They look all right to me.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: OK.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: Try those. OK.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Duke
a10o-1022909.text: Snoop, Houston. The APS looks good to us. Over.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: Roger.

a10o-1022909.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1022909.text: OK. Roger, Houston. We're about 4 minutes and 23 seconds from staging. OK, Tom, and flip it out of here. The clock's set, and we'll go in the...

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: We are Deadfaced. OK, on your side AC Bus A DECA Gimbal, Open.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: OK, let's take another look at those APS temperatures and pressures. They look all right to me.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Duke
a10a-1023557.text: Snoop, Houston. The APS looks good to us. Over.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: OK. Roger, Houston. We're about 4 minutes and 23 seconds from staging. OK, Tom, and flip it out of here. The clock's set, and we'll go in the...

a10a-1023557.speaker: Duke
a10a-1023557.text: Roger. We copy. 8 minutes to staging. Over.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: That's affirmative. We're with you. That was my mistake. It's, it's 4 minutes to our 14-minute check. We're 8 minutes to staging, 07:50.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: OK, Tom. Staging attitude should be - you should be looking at 295 upside down...

a10a-1023557.speaker: Young
a10a-1023557.text: This is Charlie Brown. you'll have to keep me posted on what Snoopy's doing. I can't read them anymore.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: ...and I should be looking at about 270 upside down.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Duke
a10a-1023557.text: Roger, Charlie Brown. Snoop's going through his staging checklist. He's got 7 minutes to go before staging.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: And I'm going to call up Verb...

a10a-1023557.speaker: Young
a10a-1023557.text: Houston, I can't read you either.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Gene-o, I'll tell you, when the ascent engine fires, we'd better be strapped down.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: OK, there's 270 coming up on 240, a little more. That's good. Right there. Stop it. OK.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: That mother may give us a kick.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: I think it will give you a kick.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: OK, Tom. If you get a chance reset my Orb Rate ball, will you, coming down. AGS agrees with the PGNS on that one.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: OK, 15:34, Tom. At 14 minutes you get the Master Arm, On, and we'll leave it On, remember, right on through the insertion burn.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Matter of fact, if you stay in AGS, I'll go ahead and set it now.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: OK. We're in AGS. I'll set the DAP.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Duke
a10a-1023557.text: Snoop, Houston. We have you Go for staging. Over.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Roger. Do you have an update on, the LM weight?

a10a-1023557.speaker: Duke
a10a-1023557.text: Roger, Snoop. Your LM weight is 8,290 [lbs, 3,755 kg]. Over.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Hey, Tom, that's good enough for CSM weight, so, that's it babe.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: You going to have the sequence camera mounted?

a10a-1023557.speaker: Duke
a10a-1023557.text: Charlie Brown, Houston:, We got it shown to high gain now, Snoop's 3 minutes from staging. Over.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: OK, let's go through our checklist.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: OK, babe. We've gone through it right up to staging. We've gone through - you want to double check these?

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Ascent Water, Open. I opened that.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: And Descent Water's Closed. I closed that. I checked the voltages, we're dead faced. We're on ascent batteries and the voltage looks good here.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: You got your breakers pulled on that side?

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: OK, at 14 minutes, put your Master Arm, On.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: OK, we're in AGS. We'll go to Attitude Hold.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: And you're in Attitude Hold; Deadband, Min; so for staging - actually be up there, if you want.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Yes, I think that would be better for stage.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: I think that would be better for stage; otherwise, you're going to banging those thrusters all over the place. Now, I should be looking at 270 upside down and you looking at 295 upside down. That's coming right in.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: We're a little bit out of plane, which won't hurt us for any separation.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: OK. And that - the DAP is set - I'll call up P47 at 11 minutes.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Let me take another look at the DAP, Tom.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: 12002. That's go. OK. Call up 47 in 1 minute. OK, Tom. I'll thrust aft [-X] 2 feet per second (0.61 m/s). I'll stop. I'll start thrusting forward [+X] and you stage-fire.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: OK. Then you got to go up to...

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: My attitude looks good. I'm coming up on 270 upside down.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: And yours is, looking good. OK. I'm calling up Noun 47.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: OK, that's that way and then that way. Right?

a10a-1023557.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Yes. I'll just take a little bit that way.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Yes, because we're going to be awful light.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Yes. We're going to - AGS is going to Mode Control.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: OK. Stay out of there, babe. OK, stay at that last attitude.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Something's wrong here. Hold it, Gene-o.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Going to try Deadband, Min here.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: AGS ready. AGS any time you want to go.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Something's wrong with the yaw rate gyro. Let's go in PGNS and Attitude Hold. OK. [Garble].

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: By the way, the DAP is set for a light vehicle. OK, we'll do it...

a10a-1023557.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: OK, hold it. We're in - OK, go.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Thrust aft. Hold it. Thrust aft. OK, ready?

a10a-1023557.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Let's go to PGNS. God damn.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: OK, let's - let's make this burn on the AGS babe.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Make this - make this burn on the AGS.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Got a good staging. Let's make it on the AGS.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: How are the AGS? Are we OK? I think we're OK, Gene-o. Proceed..

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Did you get into gimbal lock?

a10a-1023557.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Yes, but we got out of it.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: She didn't - she didn't go, huh?

a10a-1023557.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: OK, what's our - ? Did you call P00?

a10a-1023557.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: OK, what's our attitude for staging? What's our angles?

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: OK. Our angles? You didn't lock, huh?

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Something is wrong with that gyro. OK, roll is 180, pitch is 233.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Roll is 180 and pitch is what?

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: 233. You better put my ball on Inertial just to check them out and verify them, too.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: I can't reach it. So if you could put mine, you can verify it on the AGS.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Duke
a10a-1023557.text: Snoop, Houston. We show you close to gimbal lock.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Yeah, OK. Something went wild during that staging, but we're all set, we didn't lock it. We are going ahead to the Auto maneuver.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Babe, I don't know. Let's put my AGS in Inertial - in Inertial, though to verify that we're at the right attitude, babe.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Put it - OK. Just so it's in Inertial.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: OK. Because in case we have to go to it, that's what we want.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Try to get this damn thing - Sure the PGNS...

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: ...is good, huh? Wait until that thing blanks. OK, babe.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Duke
a10a-1023557.text: Charlie Brown. Houston. They - staging - they had a wild gyration though, but they got it under control. Over.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: We've got a lot of time; 7 minutes. I don't know what the hell that was, babe.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: OK, it'll be going here in...

a10a-1023557.speaker: Duke
a10a-1023557.text: Snoop, Houston. You're looking OK for the insertion burn.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Yes. Roger, Charlie. That, was something we've never seen before. It was real good. We went to AGS and...

a10a-1023557.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: You want to go through P30 again?

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: No. I went through P30. Go into P40.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: And, let me tell you what happened there real quick as we come around to this insertion burn. I went to attitude deadband, started thrusting aft, and the thing just took off on us.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: So I could see we're coming up - and we come up to insertion, so I flipped - I got a hold of it and tried to avoid gimbal lock, and guess I did. Looks like we got a good insertion out of it anyway, and - I mean, a good staging out of it and we are all set to go for insertion here.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Are we going forwards or backwards? Oh, we're going...

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: That's the way we want to go.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Yes, right, right, right. There's the Orb Rate ball; we're in good shape.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: I'll tell you, there was a moment there, Tom...

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: ...but let's worry about it after we make this burn. I want to make sure the AGS is up for it.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: OK, we're going to Auto, and I'm going to P00 - Let me call - let me call the DAP again.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: We never did go into PGNS, so the DAP didn't do it to us.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Duke
a10a-1023557.text: Snoop, Houston. Stand by for a Mark; 5 minutes to the burn.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Duke
a10a-1023557.text: Five minutes to the burn. Over.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: OK, Charlie. We're with you. I think we have got all our marbles.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: We is sure coming down to that ground, I'll tell you.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: I wonder where that [descent] stage went?

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: I don't know, but I hope we never find it again,

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Man, I'll tell you, that was wild, babe, and it wasn't the DAP, because you were in AGS. That was AGS.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: I was in AGS - I was in AGS; Mode Control, Attitude Hold. Right?

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: That's where we're going to stage. OK, babe. I've got good AGS, and everything is looking good. I've got the attitude set so if we have to switch, we'll be alright. OK. 04:07. I'll monitor it until the burn. We're 4 minutes. OK. Four minutes. Boy, that is hard to do with helmet and gloves on. Helium Monitor to Ascent Pressure 1 and 2. Let's take...

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: ...take another look at it. That's looking good. Engine Stop, push buttons, all Reset, and Abort/Abort Stage, Reset. OK.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Young
a10a-1023557.text: Houston, I'm not reading them, so if they don't make it, you've got to tell me. OK?

a10a-1023557.speaker: Duke
a10a-1023557.text: Roger. They are counting down. Looking good, Charlie Brown.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: ...Delta-V to go. OK, Tom, If - if we've got less than 170 feet - if we've got more than 170 feet per second (52 m/s) to go, we're RCS, and we'll RCS maximum, of 55 seconds, but we will RCS.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: If Delta-V is greater than 170 [fps] (52 m/s), we're RC - RCS back, to our PAD Delta-V.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: OK? Which is going to be right in P40 there.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: OK, babe. Coming up about 2 minutes.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: OK. And our PAD Delta-V is 220.9 [fps, 67.3 m/s]. So if we burn less than 170 feet per second [52 m/s] - If we don't get up to 170 feet per second [52 m/s] to go, we'll want to burn it back to about-about 220 [fps, 67 m/s]. OK?

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: But let's get over 170 [fps] (52 m/s) - let's get into that 170 feet per second (52 m/s) region.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: OK. Push your Inverter number 1, Closed, circuit breaker.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: And at 1 minute, your Stab/Control, AELD, Closed.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Boy, I'll tell you, we is down among them again going backwards, you know that?

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Look at that rille. That's got to be - that's got to be probably Diamondback right there.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: It's awful close to see that.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Yes, let's keep watching this; we're at 2 minutes, babe.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Got AELD coming Closed. Have you got yours Closed?

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: OK. Two minutes, babe. Give it a final trim.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: OK. There it is. OK. My AELD is coming Closed, Tom.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: OK. And verify your Inverter number 1 breakers, Closed.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: OK. At 35 seconds, we want the Engine Arm to Arm.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: We're in PGNS; we're in Auto.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Stafford (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: 4 Jet, Balance Couple is On. And stand by to...

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Coming right into the attitude, babe.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Got Engine Arm yet to go. Coming up on 01:12.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: I'll hit 99, and I'll count you down.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Burn time is 15 seconds, so it's going to go in a hurry.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: 50 seconds, 48. Baby, let's make this one.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: Master Arm is On, Engine Arm, Ascent; AGS Control in Auto, Deadband, Min; and we're set for this attitude on the burn and counting down 500.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: 100 [fps] (30.5 m/s) to go. 78 [fps] (24 m/s) to go. 50 [fps] (15 m/s) to go. 20 [fps] (6.1 m/s) to go. Stand by, Tom.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Duke
a10a-1023557.text: Charlie Brown, Houston. He got the burn off. We're in good shape.

a10a-1023557.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10a-1023557.text: OK. Let me get the - minus 0.3, plus 0.1...

a10a-1023557.speaker: Young
a10a-1023557.text: Outstanding. My congratulations to the Snoopy.

a10o-1023655.speaker: Duke
a10o-1023655.text: Roger. We copy. 8 minutes to staging. Over.

a10o-1023655.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1023655.text: That's affirmative. We're with you. That was my mistake. It's, it's 4 minutes to our 14-minute check. We're 8 minutes to staging, 07:50.

a10o-1023655.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1023655.text: OK, Tom. Staging attitude should be - you should be looking at 295 upside down...

a10o-1023655.speaker: Young
a10o-1023655.text: This is Charlie Brown. you'll have to keep me posted on what Snoopy's doing. I can't read them anymore.

a10o-1023655.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1023655.text: ...and I should be looking at about 270 upside down.

a10o-1023655.speaker: Duke
a10o-1023655.text: Roger, Charlie Brown. Snoop's going through his staging checklist. He's got 7 minutes to go before staging.

a10o-1023655.speaker: Cernan (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1023655.text: And I'm going to call up Verb...

a10o-1023655.speaker: Young
a10o-1023655.text: Houston, I can't read you either.

a10o-1023655.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1023655.text: Gene-o, I'll tell you, when the ascent engine fires, we'd better be strapped down.

a10o-1023655.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1023655.text: OK, there's 270 coming up on 240, a little more. That's good. Right there. Stop it. OK.

a10o-1023655.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1023655.text: That mother may give us a kick.

a10o-1023655.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1023655.text: I think it will give you a kick.

a10o-1023655.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1023655.text: OK, Tom. If you get a chance reset my Orb Rate ball, will you, coming down. AGS agrees with the PGNS on that one.

a10o-1023655.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1023655.text: OK, 15:34, Tom. At 14 minutes you get the Master Arm, On, and we'll leave it On, remember, right on through the insertion burn.

a10o-1023655.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1023655.text: Matter of fact, if you stay in AGS, I'll go ahead and set it now.

a10o-1023655.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1023655.text: OK. We're in AGS. I'll set the DAP.

a10o-1023655.speaker: Duke
a10o-1023655.text: Snoop, Houston. We have you Go for staging. Over.

a10o-1023655.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1023655.text: Roger. Do you have an update on, the LM weight?

a10o-1023655.speaker: Duke
a10o-1023655.text: Roger, Snoop. Your LM weight is 8,290 [lbs, 3,755 kg]. Over.

a10o-1023655.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1023655.text: Hey, Tom, that's good enough for CSM weight, so, that's it babe.

a10o-1023655.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1023655.text: You going to have the sequence camera mounted?

a10o-1023655.speaker: Duke
a10o-1023655.text: Charlie Brown, Houston:, We got it shown to high gain now, Snoop's 3 minutes from staging. Over.

a10o-1023655.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1023655.text: OK, let's go through our checklist.

a10o-1023655.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1023655.text: OK, babe. We've gone through it right up to staging. We've gone through - you want to double check these?

a10o-1023655.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1023655.text: Ascent Water, Open. I opened that.

a10o-1023655.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1023655.text: And Descent Water's Closed. I closed that. I checked the voltages, we're dead faced. We're on ascent batteries and the voltage looks good here.

a10o-1023655.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1023655.text: You got your breakers pulled on that side?

a10o-1023655.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1023655.text: OK, at 14 minutes, put your Master Arm, On.

a10o-1023655.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1023655.text: OK, we're in AGS. We'll go to Attitude Hold.

a10o-1023655.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1023655.text: And you're in Attitude Hold; Deadband, Min; so for staging - actually be up there, if you want.

a10o-1023655.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1023655.text: Yes, I think that would be better for stage.

a10o-1023655.speaker: Cernan (in Snoopy)
a10o-1023655.text: I think that would be better for stage; otherwise, you're going to banging those thrusters all over the place. Now, I should be looking at 270 upside down and you looking at 295 upside down. That's coming right in.

a10o-1023655.speaker: Stafford (onboard Snoopy)
a10o-1023655.text: We're a little bit out of plane, which won't hurt us for any separation.
